child.text:
[{"insert":"Cyclist Front Squat + Hamstring Walkout

This is a super set for the quads and hamstrings. The cyclist front squat raises the heels and holds the bar in the front rack to drive the work into the quads through a tall, deep squat. Move into the hamstring walkout, walking the feet out and back to load the hamstrings under a long lever. Aim for RPE 8 to 9 across all sets.
"}]
